title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Fusion Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Fusion Nic Salt is a bold, juicy medley of red fruits. Strawberry offers sweetness, Raspberry brings tartness, and Cherry adds richness for a deep, satisfying flavour. This Nic Salt is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for fast-acting nicotine relief and a smooth draw. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
